scientific_integrity: One exact finite-dimensional collision formula and its sharp simultaneous-large-hub asymptotic are proved for the canonical centered Euclidean graphical zonotope; the one-hub identity is included as a comparison only. Self-review passed, not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Both hub leaf counts must diverge for the stated asymptotic.
No uniform finite-size remainder and no arbitrary-affine-embedding extension is asserted.
Possible earlier equivalent formulations under random tree-ordering or squared normal-cone terminology remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Gaussian angular collisions on double-star graphical zonotopes
